segments.name: Blockchain Infrastructure
segments.description: Operates Ethereum validator nodes and proprietary block builders, earning ETH-denominated staking rewards and block-building fees.
segments.evidence: NodeOps and Builder+ collectively comprise the Company's blockchain infrastructure activities, while Imperium represents a distinct DeFi operating segment.

segments.name: Imperium
segments.description: Deploys ETH and stablecoins into DeFi protocols as a liquidity provider and market participant to earn variable on-chain revenues.
segments.evidence: In 2025, BTCS launched Imperium, a business line focused on deploying digital assets into decentralized finance protocols as a liquidity provider and market participant.

revenueModel.text: The company earns ETH-denominated protocol rewards and transaction fees from validation and block building, plus variable fees from DeFi protocol participation.
revenueModel.evidence: In exchange, BTCS earns ETH-denominated staking revenue, which include protocol-defined rewards and execution layer transaction fees.

changes.text: In 2025, BTCS launched Imperium as a distinct DeFi operating segment.
changes.evidence: In 2025, BTCS launched Imperium, a business line focused on deploying digital assets into decentralized finance protocols as a liquidity provider and market participant.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company discontinued validator node operations on non-Ethereum blockchains and liquidated most non-Ethereum digital asset holdings.
changes.evidence: As part of this transition, the Company discontinued validator node operations on non-Ethereum blockchains and liquidated the majority of its non-Ethereum digital asset holdings.

changes.text: The Company discontinued legacy platforms StakeSeeker in 2024 and ChainQ in 2025.
changes.evidence: The Company also discontinued the development and operation of legacy technology service platforms, including StakeSeeker in 2024 and ChainQ in 2025, in order to focus resources on scalable, revenue-generating blockchain infrastructure and DeFi activities.
